intro: The Call of Earth is a sacred shamanic rite that binds an initiate's mortal spirit to the enduring foundations of the world. By imbibing the visionary brew known as Earth Sapta at a secluded mountain Spirit Stone, the seeker learns humility, patience, and elemental awareness amid the snow and rock.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few adventurer know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.
Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... See what the earth has to show ye.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah... Friend... The earth welcomes you, even in this frozen land. Bound in body and spirit, you'll walk forward knowing the mountains are your strength, the plains your patience, and the world your essence.
To pass this rite, stand humbly before the earth. The other elements are not so still--they clash and roar. Learn their dual nature, even here among the snow and stone.
